about: Hand-audited message links on the Swarm Traces release (redacted_columns.csv, 189,579 records, pack code_traces.json): 182 links between two named tokens that Swarm Tracer v1.1.0 or the code at audit time reported, 69 more deliveries that code reported (nearly all with an anonymous run: endpoint), and 7 that appeared after the phase-1 rule changes. Each link carries endpoint_kind (named_named or involves_run).
how: v1.1.0 was checked out in a git worktree and run on the file to list its 166 named deliveries; the current code was run the same way (19). For each link the write record and the read record were read: is the write a commit/upload/POST/PUT to that same place, is the read a fetch of it, is it the same repository. A separate script (not the tool's rules) parsed the request around each mention as a cross-check (script_check); where the script and the reading differed, the reading decided. Snippets are the first mention of the place in each record, at most 120 characters. Phase 1 (2026-11-13): the other 76 links were read the same way, with the judged call printed around each mention; the rule was then changed (see amendments), and an independent second method (agenttrace/benchmark.py, independent_agreement) was scored against all labels.
labelled_by: tool-assisted reading by the authors' assistant; not independently double-labelled
limits: only links some version of the tool reported were audited, so recall is against the true links in this pool, not against every true message in the data
record text is redacted and sometimes cut; tokens are the first non-shared token in a record, which is not always the token that made the request

labels.true_message: a real write to the place, then a real read of the same place by another token
labels.false_write: the 'write' record only reads the place (GET), and POSTs or commits what it got somewhere else
labels.false_write_lfs_or_urlopen: the 'write' is a request that only fetches: an LFS batch download, Python urlopen(url), or a POST that only queries
labels.different_repo: write and read are on different repositories under one owner (the redaction kept only the owner in v1.1.0's place name)
labels.comment_only: the place is named only in a comment
labels.read_not_a_read: the write is real, but the 'read' record does not read the place (it writes to it too)
labels.unclear: cannot be decided from the two records (text cut or ambiguous); left out of precision and recall
